trigger.condition: At least one independent-panel species ledger is PARTIAL_TRANSPORT after the two frozen acquisition passes in run 36241187187.

authority_rule.if_no_partial_transport: Run 36241187187 downstream preclimate, climate and primary outputs may be authoritative subject to the frozen quality gates.
authority_rule.if_any_partial_transport: Any downstream preclimate, climate or primary outputs produced directly by run 36241187187 are provisional and must not be interpreted as the independent test result. A transport-completion execution must finish first.
authority_rule.reason: Excluding species because large GBIF responses transferred slowly could turn technical transport properties into ecological sample selection.

completion_recovery.eligible_species: Exactly species whose final run-36241187187 ledger status is PARTIAL_TRANSPORT.

post_recovery.merge_rule: For each PARTIAL_TRANSPORT species, replace only its transport ledger and occurrence rows with the completion-recovery output. All originally COMPLETE and REJECTED ledgers remain immutable.
post_recovery.if_still_partial: Species remains technical non-evaluable and is excluded by the already-frozen occurrence-transport quality gate.
post_recovery.rerun_scientific_pipeline: Recompute WGSRPD3 mapping, contemporary overlap, sampling-effort diagnostic, frozen preclimate gate, climate cross-fit and primary v0.2.1 test from the merged post-recovery occurrence set.
